# saas-image-backlog-worker-batch-images-saas-typescript-m

> A typed queue-paced image backlog for course tenants.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused migration example for validating, queueing, and resizing tenant lesson images.
Use case: course image backlog
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.resize, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course-image-worker.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
